_doc: Lending radar config. Add a sector = add an object to 'sectors'. Add a source = add to 'sources'. No code changes needed. Weights/thresholds carry last_calibrated; >180 days -> CALIBRATION_STALE warning.

weights._note: Initial expert weights, not back-tested. Output momentum and export demand carry most weight; credit-vs-output flags leverage build-up; macro overlays apply only to sensitive sectors.

thresholds._overlay_note: Macro overlays (Brent, RBI rates) shift the core sector score by at most +/- overlay_max_points; they cannot decide a verdict alone.

highlight_rules.text: Cluster whose main sector is Avoid AND its state's GST collections (Apr-to-date) are growing slower than all-India.
highlight_rules.rule: any sector verdict == Avoid and state.gst_fytd_pct < india.gst_fytd_pct

highlight_rules.text: State with GST collections falling (Apr-to-date < 0%) AND electricity demand growth below 3%.
Cluster whose sectors are all Lend AND its state's GST and electricity demand (Apr-to-date) both grow faster than all-India.
highlight_rules.rule: all sector verdicts == Lend and state.gst_fytd_pct > india and state.power_fytd_pct > india

highlight_rules.text: State with GST Apr-to-date growth ≥ 10% AND electricity demand growth ≥ 8%.
Cluster sector where bank credit is growing >20 pp faster than output (possible evergreening/over-leverage).

geo._doc: Geography verdict = national sector score blended with local (state) stress signals; ground-check ratings can only pull a call toward Caution.
